analysis: PRD paper section 4.4 ViT-B/16 design analysis
seed_policy: All new runs use the global PyTorch seed 42 set by main.py. Historical seed-42 reference units are reused without rerunning; RNG implementation differences alone do not trigger reruns.
asr_definition: 1 - adversarial accuracy over all 1000 images; no clean-correct filtering.

summary_metrics.primary: strict black-box mean ASR over the 12 targets excluding vit_base_patch16_224
summary_metrics.transformer_black_box: mean ASR over the six black-box Transformer targets
summary_metrics.cnn: mean ASR over the six CNN targets
summary_metrics.transfer_json_note: Archived transfer.json files retain transfer_eval's source-inclusive transformer_asr. The analysis summary recomputes the six-target black-box Transformer mean and the twelve-target strict black-box mean from the same per-target counts.
summary_metrics.statistics: No confidence intervals, bootstrap/resampling error bars, significance tests, McNemar tests, or p-values are computed or reported.

code_changes: tests: checkpoint traversal/budget, zero-shift identity and view count, noise RMS/structure

data.ordering: sorted adversarial PNG filenames; identical to the reference sample order hash

fixed_attack_settings.noise_rms_matching: Per-sample RMS over all initial local features and channels; feature RMS and RGB projection weights are detached; prefix/CLS unchanged.
fixed_attack_settings.gradient_aggregation: direct mean of view pixel gradients
fixed_attack_settings.update: momentum accumulation (coefficient 1), sign update, L-infinity projection

reference_compatibility.data_match: sample_order_sha256 and label_order_sha256 match the existing FPR13 provenance
reference_compatibility.parameter_match: All three reference archives match the fixed setting matrix; each reference uses batch size 48 for generation and 32 for evaluation.
reference_compatibility.evaluation_protocol_match: FPR13, all 1000 images, batch size 32, TF32 disabled, no AMP; strict black-box excludes vit_base_patch16_224.
reference_compatibility.rerun_reason: Reference units are reused unchanged per instruction; RNG differences do not require reruns.
